remainingOwnershipRequirements: A live holder cannot be evicted solely because its lock is old.
Release must affect only the lock instance owned by that holder.
Stale-owner inspection and cleanup must not remove a replacement owner lock.
Uncertain ownership must produce an observable busy/failure result without weakening mutual exclusion.
